records.issue_text: Guests are persisted before the external calendar update; if that update fails, booking attendees diverge from calendars and emails, and retries reject the guests as existing
records.rationale: Looking at addGuests.handler.ts, the code flow is: 1) prisma.booking.update() persists new guests to the database (lines 85-99), 2) eventManager.updateCalendarAttendees() updates external calendars (line 157), 3) sendAddGuestsEmails() sends emails (line 161). If step 2 fails, the guests are already persisted in the database but not in external calendars. On retry, uniqueGuests filter (lines 68-72)

records.issue_text: The handler persists filtered unique guests but sends confirmation emails to the original input list, so existing attendees can receive duplicate new-booking confirmations
records.rationale: In addGuests.handler.ts, the code filters guests to create 'uniqueGuests' (line 72-76) which excludes existing attendees, but at the end (line 171), sendAddGuestsEmails is called with the original 'guests' input, not 'uniqueGuests'. Looking at email-manager.ts sendAddGuestsEmails function (lines 522-550), it checks 'if (newGuests.includes(attendee.email))' to decide whether to send AttendeeSchedul
